info.desc: the record is the debut album by the American indie supergroup boygenius, which consists of Lucy Dacus, Julien Baker, and Phoebe Bridgers. It was released on March 31, 2023, via Interscope Records as a follow-up to their self-titled EP that was released in 2018. Three lead singles, “$20”, “ Emily, I’m Sorry” and “True Blue” were released on January 18, 2023. A fourth single, "Not Strong Enough", was released on March 1, 2023, along with a music video directed by boygenius. The Record received critical acclaim and was awarded perfect scores by the likes of DIY, NME, and Rolling Stone. .

podcast.body: This album by the indie supergroup Boygenius charted well, peaking at number 4, and had a "significant cultural impact." It was considered a strong contender for Album of the Year at the 2024 Grammys, offering a fresh option. "Their album The Record charted well peaking at number 4 and it has had a significant cultural impact".
